lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiNiO₂ is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 16-atom unit cell (Li₄Ni₄O₈) and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li and Ni each coordinated by six O neighbors, while each O is six-coordinate, surrounded by two Li and four Ni neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Li- and Ni-centered six-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between O-centered polyhedra.
